experiment: 15N-{1H} heteronuclear NOE and 15N R2/R1 ratio (spectrometers 600 and 800 MHz; field per experiment not stated)
buffer: 50 mM potassium phosphate, 50 mM NaCl, 10% (vol/vol) D2O, 0.2 mM DSS
construct_or_mutation: FtsX ECL1 (residues 46 to 168), wild type, 15N-labeled, S. pneumoniae
other_conditions: 400 µM protein for dynamics experiments; hNOE previously reported in ref 29; hNOE and R2/R1 shown in Fig. S3E-H; related structures: 6MK7 (NMR ensemble)
dynamics_type: ps-ns flexibility of termini, beta-hairpin and helical lobe (alpha2-beta5 linker); elevated R2/R1 in beta1-beta2 linker and beta-hairpin indicating ms exchange
author_claim: The beta-hairpin and helical lobe are flexible on fast ps-ns timescales, and the beta1-beta2 linker and beta-hairpin show elevated R2/R1 indicative of ms conformational exchange, whereas the core is well ordered.
anchor: The hNOE is also smaller in the β2-β3 hairpin region, as well as in the C-terminal end of the α2 helix and the subsequent coiled region leading into β5
locator: Results, 'FtsX ECL1 is dynamic in solution'; Fig. S3E-H; conditions: Methods, NMR spectroscopy
caveat_note: Residues are described only as regions (e.g. alpha2-beta5 linker, beta-hairpin residues 71 to 87) or in figures, without per-residue lists with residue types, so residues are left empty. No numerical hNOE or R2/R1 values are given in the text. R2/R1 is a qualitative indicator and not a model-free analysis; elevated R2/R1 can also reflect anisotropy or aggregation.

experiment: 15N CPMG relaxation dispersion (Rex per residue at 600 and 800 MHz)
buffer: 50 mM potassium phosphate, 50 mM NaCl, 10% (vol/vol) D2O, 0.2 mM DSS
construct_or_mutation: FtsX ECL1 (residues 46 to 168), wild type, 15N-labeled, S. pneumoniae
other_conditions: 400 µM protein for dynamics experiments; Rex plotted in Fig. S3I,J; Varian DDR 600 and 800 MHz spectrometers
dynamics_type: us-ms conformational exchange in beta-hairpin and beta1-beta2 linker
author_claim: CPMG relaxation dispersion confirms ms-timescale conformational exchange in the beta1-beta2 linker and beta-hairpin, so the beta-hairpin is flexible on both sub-ns and ms timescales.
anchor: These findings were directly confirmed by Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill (CPMG) relaxation dispersion NMR spectroscopy
locator: Results, 'FtsX ECL1 is dynamic in solution'; Fig. S3I,J; conditions: Methods, NMR spectroscopy
caveat_note: The text gives no fitted kex, populations or Rex values (only Fig. S3I,J), and no residue list with types, so the exchanging residues are left empty. The alternate state structure is not identified. The CPMG sentence refers to ref 31; the specific residues are shown only in the supplementary figure.

experiment: 1DHN residual dipolar couplings from 2D IPAP 15N,1H-HSQC in Pf1 phage, compared with back-calculated RDCs and NMR ensemble RMSD
buffer: 50 mM potassium phosphate, 50 mM NaCl, 10% (vol/vol) D2O, 0.2 mM DSS
ligand_or_partner: apo; aligned with 20 mg/ml phage Pf1
construct_or_mutation: FtsX ECL1 (residues 46 to 168), wild type, S. pneumoniae
other_conditions: RDCs used 82 (measured 112); Q factor 0.11 (0.39); related structures: 6MK7, 6HE6, 6HEE, 6HFX
dynamics_type: conformational disorder in N-terminal tail, C terminus, helical lobe loop between alpha2 and beta5, and beta-hairpin
author_claim: Near-zero RDCs at the termini and the alpha2-beta5 loop, and poor RDC agreement in the beta-hairpin, indicate significant conformational disorder in solution, matching the high RMSD regions of the NMR ensemble.
anchor: These regions of small or zero RDCs are regions of very high RMSD in the NMR structure bundle
locator: Results, 'FtsX ECL1 is dynamic in solution'; Fig. S3A-D, Table 1; conditions: Methods, NMR spectroscopy
caveat_note: RDCs report amplitude-averaged orientational disorder across timescales up to ms and do not give a rate. Residue ranges for hypermobile regions (45 to 58, 119 to 133, 165 to 168) are given without residue types, so residues are left empty.

experiment: Comparison of six independent crystal structures (three detergent co-crystals, two chains each) with each other and with the NMR ensemble
buffer: 0.1 M sodium citrate, 0.2 M potassium-sodium tartrate, 2 M ammonium sulfate
ligand_or_partner: dodecyltrimethylammonium chloride (D1, 46 µM), n-undecyl-beta-D-maltoside (D2, 0.59 mM), n-decyl-beta-D-maltoside (D3, 1.8 mM)
construct_or_mutation: FtsX ECL1 (residues 46 to 168), wild type, S. pneumoniae
other_conditions: Crystals grown at 291 K, data collected at 100 K; resolution 2.0 to 2.3 Å; related structures: 6MK7 (NMR ensemble), 4N8N (M. tuberculosis FtsX ECD, comparison only)
dynamics_type: ligand-coupled conformational change of helical lobe and beta-hairpin; crystal B factors and structural variation
alt_state_structure: 6HE6: helical lobe and beta-hairpin conformation bound to detergent D1 (chain A, holo) versus apo-like chain B (Fig. 1C, Fig. S1B); 6HEE: conformation with detergent D2 bound (Fig. S1B); 6HFX: conformation with detergent D3 bound (Fig. S1B)
author_claim: The beta-hairpin and helical lobe adopt different conformations depending on bound detergent, with smaller variation than in the NMR bundle, and these variable regions correspond to the highly dynamic regions seen by NMR.
anchor: As expected, regions presenting structural variations in crystal structures correspond to those showing a highly dynamic behavior by NMR.
locator: Results, 'The three-dimensional structure of FtsX ECL1'; Fig. 1C,E, Fig. S1B, Table 2; conditions: Methods, X-ray crystallography
caveat_note: This is a static structural comparison at 100 K, not a measured exchange rate or population. Conformational differences are induced by detergent ligands with unknown physiological role, so they do not identify the solution exchange process seen by CPMG. Fig. 1C is cited for residues; the six-structure assignments to PDB ids follow D1, D2 and D3 given in Table 2. Paper residue numbers follow full-length FtsX; entry positions are paper number minus 42 (entry begins with a GAM tag before paper residue 46), checked residue by residue against the entry sequence.
